## Purpose

Usage: hotam sync-domain --domain <path> [--today YYYY-MM-DD] [--confirm-hash <hex>] [--reason "..."] [--ack-conflict <C-id>] [--decision-ref "..."] [--json]. Mirrors a CONSUMER domain's own Go requirements registry (spec/requirements.go, read via a `go run ./registrydump` subprocess inside the domain's own spec/ module) onto that domain's graph.json — the domain-scoped generalization of hotam sync-self (task #366, RAC2 Phase B). Same dry-run-by-default / --confirm-hash handshake and confront/violation/append-only gate order as sync-self.
